t_advice_summary_textbox.text: That no discernible pattern to the best gnomes/likeliest to result in a high reward could be detected.

vb_textbox.text: There doesn't seem to be a discernible pattern to latch onto. As it is, I believe the patterns rotate throughout the experiment. For example, for 10-20 rounds, the best option will be one with a taller hat. For the next 10-20 rounds, the best option might be the ones on the left side. And so on.
